purpose: Build a survivorship-free daily panel of every Hyperliquid vault (open and closed) for a later, separately pre-registered study of vault return dispersion and persistence. Closed vaults drop out of listings over time, so collection starts before any study design.
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-12. Collection only: no return statistic, ranking or persistence measure is computed until a study is registered in its own config. Free public data only.
fields_per_vault_per_day: last value of each pnl series (day, week, month, allTime)
schedule: daily, via the Branch Forward Scheduler on main
storage: compact gzip JSONL per snapshot date, carried forward in the artifact hyperliquid-vaults-panel-v1; the panel never shrinks
